free_tier.stated: 超级会员 is sold by the month. The vendor's own table gives the non-member column (普通用户) a 10GB cloud drive, 10-day recycle bin, 5 GB per month of cloud-drive high-speed download ('非会员：5GB/月') and a speed table entry of 586 KB/s against 15.8 MB/s for 超级会员.
free_tier.notes: The vendor page vip.xunlei.com/vip_service/supervip_info/dist/ was read on 2026-11-03.

per_object_cap.stated: Not published. 云添加 accepts up to 500 files per submission and the drive is 10 to 12 TB, so the practical unit is a task, not a byte.

retention.stated: 云盘回收站: the vendor table lists 保留60天 (年费超级会员), 保留30天 (超级会员), 保留15天 (白金会员) and 保留10天 (普通用户). Files not deleted are kept while the membership runs.

egress.terms: The vendor page states the cloud-drive high-speed download volume by member level: 超级会员等级1-3：2TB/月、超级会员等级4-6：6TB/月，超级会员等级7-10：12TB/月、白金会员：1TB/月、非会员：5GB/月. A third-party article quoting the vendor's promotion states 月度支持10TB云盘高速取回. When the volume is used up the task runs at normal speed.
egress.free_allowance: 5 GB/month of 云盘高速下载 for a non-member; 10 TB/month is the third-party figure for the annual membership

interface_detail: Vendor client only. 云添加 takes magnet, ed2k and http(s) links, and third-party tools drive it through a user's own endpoints rather than a published API. No public API was found on any page read.
tooling: Official Windows, macOS, Android and iOS clients; the 云添加 queue accepts magnet/ed2k/http in batch. No rclone backend exists for 迅雷云盘.
chaining: Retrieval is a monthly allowance inside the membership, set by the member level: 超级会员等级1-3：2TB/月、超级会员等级4-6：6TB/月，超级会员等级7-10：12TB/月、白金会员：1TB/月、非会员：5GB/月 on the vendor page (a third-party article states 月度支持10TB云盘高速取回). The card price is in price_per_tb_month.

identity_cost.detail: The client's login offers a phone number plus 微信/QQ QR login. No email-only path was found and the login page at i.xunlei.com returned an empty document to every reader tried, so whether a non-mainland number is accepted was not established. Phone is the gate; the country rule is unverified.

reliability_note: a lapsed membership stops retrieval of files already stored.

The login page was not readable; one purchase and one 云添加 would raise this to measured.

notes: Drive size by source: IT之家 and 新浪 say 12 TB, the 会员省 price index says 10 TB, and the vendor privilege table lists 12T (年费超级会员), 6T (超级会员), 3T (白金会员) and 10GB (普通用户). 迅雷's 离线 function no longer exists as a standalone product; the cloud-add queue is what replaced it.
binding_note: 10 TB/month of high-speed retrieval is the first wall at 1 TiB/month only if a user also counts uploads; the real constraint for a user is that retrieval is inside a membership, not sold per byte, so the quota binds before any shaping does.
